title: agloss: code and results for "Guidance versus Confinement: What Anatomical Supervision of Grad-CAM Does and Does Not Change"
description:
PyTorch code and result files for the manuscript Guidance versus Confinement: What Anatomical Supervision of Grad-CAM Does and Does Not Change (under review).

The package agloss trains tuberculosis chest X-ray classifiers (ResNet-50, ConvNeXt-Tiny) with and without spatial supervision of Grad-CAM: anatomical guidance (the Anatomical Guidance loss), anatomical confinement (Tversky), and their ablations. It runs the full experiment grid (336 training runs: two datasets, eight seeds), the cross-dataset transfer evaluation, and the reliance analyses (occlusion, region ablation, deletion-insertion). Two commands reproduce every experiment; the included result CSVs reproduce every table and figure without a GPU.

The Shenzhen and Montgomery County datasets and the Shenzhen lung masks are not included; they are publicly available from the U.S. National Library of Medicine and Kaggle (see README).
